description: This Java class defines the BaseUnretireHandler, which implements functionality to 'unretire' (reactivate) objects implementing the Retireable interface in the OpenMRS system. It handles resetting retirement-related attributes such as retired status, retire reason, retired by user, and date retired.

classes.name: BaseUnretireHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for unretiring Retireable objects by resetting their retirement-related attributes.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Resets the retirement attributes of a Retireable object to mark it as not retired, if it is currently retired and matches the specified criteria.
